claim_boundary: Tests whether the finite Green-preserving boundary sewing can serve as a same-carrier reciprocal constructor on the pole-cancelling radial source range.

disposition.meaning: W is a Green-preserving sewing between oppositely polarized boundary relations, not a reciprocal endomorphism of the same pole-cancelling source range.
disposition.supersedes: the action-axis wording in prime_two_radial_scc_profile_audit.v1.json; W is faithful as an abstract boundary C2 representation but cannot be used as the SCC constructor action on c_radial
disposition.first_missing_typed_datum: a source reciprocal map between the correctly polarized plus and minus source-range relations, with its codomain relation declared separately
